description: The one standalone Todos window opens the Epicenter-root default, bound by Rust before its WebView exists. The static page calls openFolder with its schema and passes no path. General folder selection belongs to Epicenter's launcher; standalone Todos has no picker or extra-folder windows. The page refreshes visible queries, asks for confirmation when its Folder has an unfinished save, and may ask Rust to hand its bound folder to Epicenter.
